post.summary: OIDC back-channel logout: the provider posts a signed logout token, no cookie.

get.summary: Return from the identity provider; checks state and PKCE, opens the session.
Starts AAI@EduHr login (PKCE); returnTo is narrowed to a safe local path.

post.summary: Closes every session of the caller; on failure keeps the cookie.
Closes the current session. Same Origin only; an empty body.
One evidence segment and the document after it. Same Origin, `ductus-protocol: 1` (signed now, 200) or `2` (signed by the worker: 202 pending_signature, then the same request again).

202.description: stored, receipt pending_signature (protocol 2 only); not an acknowledgement

post.summary: The caller's own work for one assignment and its current revision; `start: true` makes it. Same Origin, `ductus-protocol: 1`; anyone but the student gets 404.

get.summary: Liveness: the process answers. Reads no database, session or environment.

200.description: alive. Since 1.3.0 also the state of the main database (`state`, checked with a time limit) and the versions; never an address, a name or an error.

state.description: degraded: the main database is not ok or did not answer in time

minClientVersion.description: oldest client version this server serves

get.summary: Readiness per capability, closed words only.
Public status in three parts, closed words, nothing about a person.
The caller's saved interface language, or null.

post.summary: Saves the caller's interface language. Canonical JSON, nothing but the locale.

get.summary: The settings catalogue: every key, the levels that may hold it, its kind, default and hard limits.

The rows of one level in the caller's scope (course names the course for the course level and is absent for every other), and for every catalogue key of that level the value that holds without it (source: a higher level or default) and the narrowest higher bound. A level or course that is not the caller's gives 404, the same as a course that does not exist (C-23: another's is nonexistent).

200.description: the level's rows and what it inherits

put.summary: Sets the caller's value and bound of one key at one level (the bound as locked, min and max); no value and no bound remove the row and the level above holds again. course is a course id for the course level and null for every other. A level or course that is not the caller's gives 404, the same as a course that does not exist. A key outside the catalogue, a level the catalogue does not allow for it, a value of the wrong kind or out of its limits and a bound of a wrong shape give 422; crossing a higher bound gives 409. A refusal of the catalogue (422) comes before the level check (404), as in settings.set_value. 409 needs a key a lower level holds under a higher bound; the first catalogue has none, so its vector shows the shape only. Every change is kept with its author, time, old and new value.

200.description: saved (changed is false when the row already held it)

get.summary: The courses of the caller's open student memberships and the current version of every assignment in each. Courses by name (hr collation), then id; assignments by due time, then id. The identity comes from the session only.

200.description: ready (an empty list when the student has no course)

post.summary: Sends a problem report: the user's description and a closed technical context. The body is the JCS form of the value, at most 8 KiB; the description is 1 to 1000 code points with a visible character and no control or bidi character other than newline and tab (checked by the server, answered 422). At most five reports per account in an hour.

201.description: recorded; the reference the user quotes

get.summary: The teacher's courses and their assignments (institution.list_teacher_courses). Courses by academic year descending, then name (hr collation), then id; assignments by due time, then title, then id. Each course carries its rule on AI help, which a new assignment may only keep or narrow.

post.summary: The teacher's fast path through the works of one assignment (B-11, #757): per student the state of the work, its text as blocks and the same process summary the student sees. POST so the assignment id never lands in a URL; the body is exactly {assignmentId}, a UUID in any case, at most 1 KiB; any other key or a malformed id is 422 invalid_input. An assignment the caller does not teach, or that does not exist, is the same empty list, never 403 or 404. Named students by surname, given name (hr) and id, then the unnamed by id.

get.summary: One open mentorship of the caller as mentor. Another institution's, an ended one, an unknown and a malformed id all read the same 404.
The open mentorships of the caller as mentor, newest first; anyone else gets the same empty list. No time, activity or count of a work.

Which students of an assignment submitted, with the work each row links to, for the assignment's teacher; one row per student with an open membership, by student id. Anyone else, an unknown or a malformed id gets the same empty list. No text, name, exact time, deadline, hash or submission id.
